mechanism: Atorvastatin is metabolized by CYP3A4, and methylphenidate may have minor CYP3A4 inhibitory effects; additionally, methylphenidate's sympathomimetic activity may theoretically potentiate cardiovascular stress in patients on statins.
action: Monitor for statin efficacy and muscle symptoms; baseline lipid panel recommended, with follow-up monitoring if methylphenidate is initiated or discontinued.
